meta.title: mex-scrape
meta.description: Compare Mexican store prices with Amazon.com.mx and work out your ROI.

home.heading: mex-scrape
home.intro: Find products from Mexican stores that you can resell at a profit on Amazon.com.mx.

search.title: Search for a product
search.body: Type a name or code and see offers from Mexican stores.

compare.title: Compare with Amazon
compare.body: See the same product’s price on Amazon.com.mx and how it has changed.

profit.title: Work out your profit
profit.body: Take off fees, shipping and prep to see your profit and ROI.

onboarding.heading: Your memberships
onboarding.intro: Some stores only sell to members. Tick the memberships you hold and we will hide offers you cannot buy.
onboarding.hint: You can change them later in Account.

search.heading: Search products
search.label: Product to search for

status.network: The connection dropped during the search.

costs.heading: Your per-unit costs
costs.hint: Saved in this browser and used in every search and in the calculator.
costs.invalid: Enter amounts in pesos, like 15 or 15.50.

detail.openStore: View at {store} (opens in a new tab)
detail.reviewHint: Is it the same product as on Amazon? Confirm it to use this price, or discard it.

calculator.heading: Cost calculator
calculator.intro: Work out a product's profit and ROI with the same maths as search.

errors.invalidAmount: Could not calculate: the amounts must be positive numbers. Check them and try again.
errors.zero_units: Could not calculate: enter units per month to spread the fixed costs.
errors.overflow: Could not calculate: the amounts are too large. Use smaller amounts.
errors.invalidFields: Could not calculate. Check the marked fields.

calculator.resultEmpty: Enter the prices and press Calculate to see the profit and ROI.

fieldErrors.amount: Use numbers only, with up to 2 decimals, for example 1299.50.
fieldErrors.units: Use a whole number, for example 30.
fieldErrors.zeroUnits: Enter how many units you sell per month.

assistant.heading: Assistant
assistant.intro: Ask about your tracked products, prices for seasons like Hot Sale or Buen Fin, ROI, or matches that need review.
assistant.disclaimer: The assistant uses data from your searches in the last 90 days and can be wrong. Check before you buy.
assistant.label: Your question
assistant.placeholder: E.g. Should I buy B0E2ETEST1 before Buen Fin?
assistant.accepted: Match accepted. Your searches now show it.
assistant.rejected: Match rejected. Your searches no longer show it.

errors.agent_budget: You reached the assistant's daily limit. Try again tomorrow.
errors.agent_busy: The assistant is still answering your previous question. Wait a moment.
errors.invalid_messages: The conversation is too long or has an empty message. Start a new one.
errors.agent_failed: The assistant could not answer. Try again.
errors.agent_timeout: The assistant took too long. Try again.
errors.agent_unavailable: The assistant is not available right now.
errors.not_reviewable: That match no longer needs review in your searches.
errors.suggestion_mismatch: The proposal does not match the product. Reload and try again.

account.heading: Your account
account.signedOutIntro: Sign in to see your account, or create a new one.
